verification_method: Each URL was fetched on 2026-11-18; the portal title and reachability were confirmed. The portal pages are client-rendered, so the text of each service was confirmed from the operator's published pages rather than scraped.
disclaimer: This is awareness information, not legal advice. Use the official portal or helpline for a real complaint.

channels.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
channels.operator: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
channels.purpose: File a cybercrime complaint online, including financial fraud, and track it.

channels.name: Cyber fraud helpline 1930
channels.operator: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
channels.purpose: Report financial cyber fraud quickly so that banks can try to stop the transfer.
channels.note: The number is published by the national portal. If it does not connect, use the portal to file the complaint.

channels.name: RBI Sachet
channels.purpose: Report unauthorised deposit-taking and unregistered financial schemes.

channels.name: CERT-In
channels.operator: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
channels.purpose: Report cyber security incidents such as phishing infrastructure and malware.
